assets.name: rats-buildings
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite atlas. Create ONE transparent PNG sprite sheet, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, 9 separate evenly spaced isometric pixel-art RAT CLAN sewer village buildings. Each sprite fully inside its own equal cell with generous transparent margins, no overlap. Top row: (1) grand Rat King's sewer citadel with copper crown dome, green-lit culvert arches and pipes; (2) humble rat warren brick sewer dwelling with round entrance and rusty pipe; (3) scout lodge low sewer watchtower with red tiny pennant. Middle row: (4) Rat Mage apothecary crooked stone tower glowing violet-green crystals; (5) bulky iron sewer guard barracks spiked drainage gate; (6) underground salvage market stall with cheese crates and brass coins. Bottom row: (7) sewer mushroom farm, bioluminescent green beds and water trough; (8) plague-bell support tower with green brass bell; (9) alchemy vat support workshop bubbling green tank. Authentic meticulously hand-placed-looking chunky 32-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, no smoothing, readable silhouettes at 90px, top down isometric three quarter view consistent all sprites. Muted stone blue gray, oxidized copper, moss green, little warm windows. Buildings only, no characters, no text or labels, no grid lines, no ground tiles, no drop-shadow rectangle. Genuinely transparent background.

assets.name: rats-units
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: animated game character sprite atlas. Create a single PNG on truly transparent background, EXACTLY 6 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS in a precise uniform grid. Each cell contains ONE small anthropomorphic fantasy fighter facing to the right, three-quarter isometric camera. Each ROW is a different RAT unit. Six columns show animation: 1 idle with weapon ready, 2 running left-foot forward, 3 running right-foot forward, 4 attack windup, 5 attack extended, 6 recovery. ROW 1: small gray sewer rat with pink ears and tail, rusty short dagger, ragged red scarf. ROW 2: slim brown rat scout with hood and short bow. ROW 3: rat mage in purple robe with luminous green staff. ROW 4: royal Rat King with gold crown, red cape, curved sword. Exaggerated animal faces and ears, cute but battle-ready, strong varied silhouettes. Coarse authentic 32-bit pixel art, crisp hard pixel edges, no vector or smooth illustration. Muted charcoal browns, warm highlights, limited palette. Separate evenly spaced sprites same scale, feet on consistent baseline within each equal cell, ample transparent padding, no overlap, all bodies visible, no text, no labels, no ground, no sheet border. All 24 cells must be present.

assets.name: terrain
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: entire terrain map backdrop for isometric pixel-art village autobattler, WIDE LANDSCAPE 1800x1000 composition. Camera high overhead three-quarter isometric, zero horizon, entire frame is terrain. Two broad grassy village clearings, one centered at 25% width 50% height, other centered at 75% width 50% height, separated by a NARROW winding blue river running top to bottom at exact center. One broad old mossy stone bridge connects both clearings across center of frame horizontally. VERY IMPORTANT: both clearings each have a very large EMPTY nearly flat muted olive grass-and-dirt center approximately 650px wide and 470px high; NO objects or trees inside them, so game buildings will be placed there. Cluster lovely detailed deciduous and pine trees, gray rock cliffs, mushrooms, ferns and reeds ONLY around outside perimeter and river banks. Dark teal stream, autumn russet and deep green foliage, golden evening light, moody cozy woodland. Beautiful chunky genuine 32-bit pixel art, deliberate square pixels and hard edges, rich earthy limited colors, no smooth painterly blur. Soft natural dirt trails approach stone bridge. Organic terrain without visible hex tiles. No houses, NO buildings, NO units, NO writing, NO UI, NO grid, NO watermark. Clearings must remain visually uncluttered and light enough for building silhouettes.

assets.name: vfx
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game VFX animation sprite atlas. TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG, 4 columns by 4 rows with equal square cells and generous padding. Row 1 four sequential animation frames of a bright ivory sword slash crescent, beginning tiny, full sweep, trailing arc, dissolving sparks. Row 2 four sequential frames of a green poisonous spell explosion, central spark, burst, emerald cloud ring, fading droplets. Row 3 four sequential frames of icy blue moon-magic explosion, star, bright burst, blue ring, scattered shards. Row 4 four sequential frames of cyan wolf howl aura, small rune ring, expanding circle, wide luminous ring with angular wolf spirit, fading motes. Game-ready coarse PIXEL ART, bright limited colors, hard pixel edges, powerful readable shapes. Keep every frame contained in its equal cell, no overlaps. Background genuinely transparent alpha zero, not black, no gradient background, NO labels, NO text.

processing: Generated alpha preserved; building sprites extracted by connected components; nearest-neighbor resized for runtime. Original PNGs remain in the local burrow-and-fang-work folder.
